method: Command rows: every method in build/reference-2.3.json plus plugin metadata (onscreen-keyboard, print-table, sound-advanced) and plugin commands without metadata (polygon, vis). A test file references a command when it calls it ($.name( / .name( ) or names it as a string. Static; confirmed by reading for zero- and single-reference rows. Contract rows: the 2.2 audit findings (git show 991e340^:docs/SYSTEM-AUDIT-2.2.md) and the files that check them.
